extracted.name: Chef John's Tarragon Aioli
extracted.description: Chef John's recipe for homemade aioli with tarragon is the perfect accompaniment to fish, meat, or vegetables.
ingredient_lines: 1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste
instruction_lines: Crush garlic and salt together in a mortar with a pestle; add tarragon and continue crushing with the pestle until tarragon is pulverized.
Stir mayonnaise and lemon juice into garlic-tarragon mixture until aioli is smooth; season with cayenne pepper.
